name: Sakai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakai city emblem in blue: three stylised 市 (city) marks joined into a single radiating device.
history: Sakai's emblem, among the oldest municipal marks in Japan (1894), triples the character 市 to express the city's position at the boundary of three historic provinces.

features.role: Sakai city emblem — three joined 市 marks
features.symbolism: Sakai grew at the boundary of the old provinces of Settsu, Kawachi and Izumi — its name means 'boundary' — and the tripled mark expresses that three-way meeting
